description: Grade a rendered frame and return integer corrections. THE CRITIC IS DETERMINISTIC, NOT A MODEL: nine cells must reach the same verdict or the fleet's byte-identity is gone, and a cell reports generative:0 because it hosts no model. Scores 0-1000 and returns span/pitch deltas as integers.
